# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- In the FlowRate project, always update README.md, CHANGELOG.md, TODO.md, and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md upon each iteration (no null/empty updates); understand each file's purpose so updates are meaningful.
- Every iteration must end with `git add`, `commit`, and `push` to GitHub (origin/main) in addition to updating README.md, CHANGELOG.md, TODO.md, and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.
- For branding, publisher, owner, or identity fields, use "flowrate.tech" / "FlowRate.tech" instead of "RejectH0".
